title: Power Apps: out-of-the-box Application Insights telemetry for generative pages
notes: claim 41: severity major on a rationale: impact rating lowered to minor; ratings are judgements and cannot hold a page
summary: The admin path, role requirements, telemetry signals and workspace billing are supported by Microsoft documentation, and the availability fields match the roadmap. The categorical assurances about autonomous actions and end-user impact need narrowing, and the governance checklist names controls missing from the table.

claims.claim: Azure role-based access controls access to the exported Application Insights data.
claims.quote: This setup provides full access to Log Analytics features, consolidates logs in one location, and allows for unified Azure role-based access control

claims.claim: There are no autonomous actions and the feature only observes activity.
claims.quote: Searched: "generative pages" "Application Insights" "autonomous" actions telemetry. Opened generative-pages and analyze-telemetry; they describe exported signals, not an explicit guarantee of no actions.
claims.fix: Replace 'None. The feature only observes activity.' with 'The documented capability exports page-load, error, data-operation and navigation telemetry.'

claims.where: front matter: licensing.notes; Cost and licensing; Governance controls; rationale: cost
claims.claim: Application Insights data ingestion and retention are billed through the associated Log Analytics workspace.
claims.quote: Data ingestion and retention for workspace-based Application Insights resources are billed through the Log Analytics workspace where the data is located.

claims.where: front matter: licensing.notes; Cost and licensing
claims.claim: Exact charges depend on workspace configuration and telemetry volume.
claims.quote: The default pricing for Log Analytics is a pay-as-you-go model that's based on ingested data volume and data retention.

claims.claim: The Log Analytics workspace can be in a different subscription from the Application Insights resource.
claims.quote: When you create or update a workspace-based Application Insights resource and link it to a Log Analytics workspace in a different subscription

claims.claim: Application Insights enablement is limited to customers with paid/premium Dataverse licences available for the tenant.
claims.quote: Enablement of Application Insights is limited to customers with a paid/premium Dataverse licenses available for the tenant.

claims.claim: A telemetry-specific Power Apps licence or credit requirement for generative pages is not published as of November 2026.
claims.quote: Searched: "generative pages" "Application Insights" "credits" licensing pricing. Opened generative-pages, analyze-telemetry and cost-logs; found Dataverse prerequisites and Azure billing, not a telemetry-specific Power Apps requirement.

claims.claim: Specific telemetry-volume costing guidance for generative pages is not published.
claims.quote: Searched: generative pages Application Insights telemetry disable per page switch Power Apps licence credits pricing; "generative pages" "Application Insights" "credits" licensing pricing. Opened generative-pages and cost-logs; no page-specific volume guidance found.

claims.claim: The Power Platform admin center path is Manage > Data export > App Insights > New data export.
claims.quote: In the navigation pane, select Manage. In the Manage pane, select Data export. On the Data export page, select the App Insights tab. Then select New data export.

claims.claim: An equivalent automation interface for configuring Power Platform Application Insights export is not documented as of November 2026.
claims.quote: Searched: Power Platform Application Insights data export configuration API PowerShell pac admin export telemetry; Power Platform API Application Insights data export; pac admin Insights; PowerApps PowerShell Application Insights export. Read export setup and reference excerpts; no equivalent found.

claims.claim: The environment export feature is supported only for Managed Environments.
claims.quote: This feature is turned on and supported for managed environments only.

claims.claim: Configuration requires the Power Platform administrator or Dynamics 365 administrator role at tenant level.
claims.quote: being assigned to the Power Platform administrator or Dynamics 365 administrator role at the tenant-level in Microsoft Entra ID

claims.claim: Configuration additionally requires environment administrator or system administrator in the Dataverse environment.
claims.quote: and by being assigned to the environment administrator or system administrator role within the Dataverse environment. Without these permissions, the integration doesn't work.

claims.where: controls[1].ui and controls[1].api; controls[1].note; Open questions
claims.claim: Microsoft has not documented a per-page telemetry switch through UI or API as of November 2026.
claims.quote: Searched: "generative pages" "telemetry" "disable"; "generative pages" "Application Insights" "per-page" switch API. Read generative-pages and generative-page-external-tools excerpts; they describe environment export, not a per-page switch.

claims.claim: The feature is admin-opt-in because an administrator must configure environment export.
claims.quote: To export generative page telemetry to Azure Application Insights (preview), an administrator must set up Application Insights data export for the environment in the Power Platform admin center.

claims.claim: The licensing model is consumption, reflecting Azure telemetry billing.
claims.quote: Because workspace-based Application Insights resources store their data in a Log Analytics workspace, the billing for data ingestion and retention is done by the workspace where the Application Insights data is located.

claims.claim: Learn advises configuring daily caps for both Application Insights and Log Analytics.
claims.quote: You should configure the daily cap setting for both Application Insights and Log Analytics to limit the amount of telemetry data ingested by your service.

claims.claim: For workspace-based Application Insights resources the effective daily cap is the minimum of the two settings.
claims.quote: For workspace-based Application Insights resources, the effective daily cap is the minimum of the two settings.

claims.claim: Admins and developers can see generative page telemetry.
claims.quote: Admins and developers can monitor published generative pages with Application Insights.

claims.claim: End users notice nothing.
claims.quote: Searched: "generative pages" "telemetry" "performance" "users". Opened generative-pages and analyze-telemetry; neither guarantees that telemetry causes no user-visible effects.
claims.fix: Remove 'end users notice nothing' from the impact rationale; retain 'Low. Admins and developers see the telemetry.'

claims.claim: The generative page telemetry documentation does not list record content among the exported fields.
claims.quote: Searched: "generative pages" "telemetry" "record content". Read generative-pages telemetry table: page metadata, errors, operation durations/results and navigation information are listed; record content is not listed.

claims.where: Governance guidance: Before rollout and After rollout; Governance controls
claims.claim: The governance checklist names retention, access and exception-alert controls that have no corresponding controls-table rows.
claims.quote: Checklist: 'Set retention and access for the telemetry' and 'Build alerts on exceptions for critical pages.' The table contains only environment export and an individual-page telemetry switch.
claims.fix: Remove the checklist bullets 'Set retention and access for the telemetry' and 'Build alerts on exceptions for critical pages'; these instructions name controls absent from the table.

claims.where: front matter: cost; rationale: cost; Why it matters
claims.claim: Cost is variable because the feature adds telemetry subject to Azure ingestion and retention billing.
claims.quote: The default pricing for Log Analytics is a pay-as-you-go model that's based on ingested data volume and data retention.
